messages:
ana: Kicked off SummitBridge co-marketing plan. Deliverables: joint benchmark blog, marketplace listing copy, and a technical webinar + demo. Target dates: webinar 10/12, blog 10/14, marketplace promo 10/15-10/21.
cooper: Goals: drive marketplace-origin trials, measure p95 latency, and show per-token delta on small-chat workloads. Attribution from marketplace is top priority.
mei: I'll own landing page + marketplace blurb. Need bench CSV + reproducibility notes from eng by Wed so copy can lock.
frank: Eng will drop `summitbridge_bench_10_2026.csv` and a README with model, seq_len, concurrency, and harness config by Tue EOD.
ana: Messaging guardrails: use "observed up to X%" phrasing. example: "observed up to 27% lower token cost in our test harness" and link to methodology. No blanket guarantees.
zoe: Ops: routing rules -> SFDC Campaign = "SummitBridge-MP-2026"; set hidden field origin=summitbridge_marketplace; zap to #sdr-marketplace. Create campaign member mapping for marketplace leads.
cooper: Tracking: utm_source=summitbridge_marketplace, utm_campaign=sumb-10-26, utm_medium=referral. Hidden form field `partner_ref=SUM-1026`. I'll supply GTM snippet once LP is live.
mei: Landing page CTA will be `Start marketplace trial`. I'll prepare 3 headline variants (2 technical, 1 product) and run an A/B on headline for 48-72h.
frank: Demo plan: containerized reproducible demo: `docker run redwood/summitbridge-demo:bench-v1 -p 8080:8080 --config short-chat.yaml`. Will include runbook and sanitized CSV.
ana: Webinar format: 20m joint product + partner overview, 20m benchmark deep-dive, 15m live demo, 15m Q&A. Need rehearsal week of 10/5.
ops-bot: Rehearsal event created -> 1828330000 (calendar invite).
zoe: Lead handling: if lead.company_size > 150 and intent=POC -> escalate to enterprise SDRs within 24h. Else route to integrations SDR pool. Tag leads: marketplace=true, partner=summitbridge.
cooper: Lead scoring tweak: marketplace leads with company_size>50 that convert to trial and use >8k tokens in first 7 days get flagged for growth@redwood follow-up.
mei: Social plan: short X thread + LinkedIn long-form + 2 co-branded cards. I'll prepare copy and schedule for promo week. Need visuals from partner by 10/1.
frank: Legal dependency: SummitBridge legal must sign co-marketing agreement and logo use by 9/28. If delayed, webinar can continue internally but public benchmark post slides to 10/21.
ana: Measurement: create funnel in analytics for marketplace_landing -> registration -> trial_activation -> first_10k_tokens. Tag events with partner_ref.
zoe: Ops detail: SFDC web-to-lead must set `campaign_id` and `external_source = summitbridge_mp`. Also add an auto-assignment rule for origin=summitbridge_marketplace -> queue `sdr-integrations`.
cooper: Also add a zap: marketplace registration -> post to #sdr-triage with lead summary and direct link to SFDC.
mei: I'll draft an FAQ for webinar (6-8 Qs) and a short reproducibility appendix for the blog (config, seq lengths, concurrency). No raw logs.
frank: We'll sanitize CSV to drop internal hostnames and creds. Provide exact model name and tokenization notes.
ana: Action recap: Mei (LP + social + headlines + FAQ), Frank (bench CSV + demo container + readme), Zoe (SFDC rules + zap + routing), Cooper (tracking + GTM + measurement), Ana (partner liaison + host + comms).
cooper: Reminder: do not publish any external materials until legal signoff AND landing page tracking is verified. We'll do an internal dry run 10/6.
ops-bot: Legal approval reminder -> 1695880000.
ana: Final ask: prepare short copy blocks for engineering audience and product audience for PR and partner channels. Meeting to finalize Fri 9/29 9am PT. :rocket:
